body: Events stamp the HEAD of the checkout they run in. A close from a feature branch points at a commit that disappears after rebase/squash and shows as '(abc1234?)'. That is by design and the '?' marker is the answer, but one sentence in the lifecycle should say: on branches that will be rebased or squashed, close the ticket after the merge, from the branch that keeps the commit. No --commit override (declined under T-186's discussion).
title: SKILL.md: close after merge when working on branches that get rebased
